profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker SMCI and headquartered in San Jose, California. Its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001375365. On its own website the company describes itself as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for the 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide.

The site presents the company's AI position around GPU servers for modern data centers, describing a line of AI systems built with multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also points to short-depth and small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company's recorded litigation exposure sits in California, with a count of 281.
